# Hotel Equities strengthens leadership team with new appointments

283

04.05.2026

Left to right: Kenneth Zahn, Nolan Wrentmore, and John Mootz.

Hotel Equities expands its leadership structure with new appointments across sales, revenue and food and beverage operations, supporting portfolio performance and operational growth across its focused service and lifestyle divisions.

Hotel Equities announced the expansion of its leadership team with a series of appointments across sales, revenue management and food and beverage operations.

Kenneth Zahn joins as Vice President of Sales, Focused Service, where he will oversee sales strategy and revenue performance across the division. Zahn brings experience in leading multi-property and multi-brand portfolios, most recently serving as Vice President of Sales at PHMI Group, where he directed commercial strategy across Marriott, IHG and Choice assets generating more than $45 million in annual revenue. In his new role, he will work closely with the company’s commercial leadership to support sales execution and portfolio performance.

Nolan Wrentmore has been appointed Vice President of Revenue, Lifestyle Division, bringing more than 25 years of experience in revenue strategy, distribution and commercial operations. Based in Frisco, Texas, Wrentmore most recently led revenue initiatives at Hosteeva, contributing to the division’s growth of more than 100 percent. Prior to that, he spent over a decade with Aimbridge Hospitality, overseeing a team responsible for more than $1 billion in annual revenue. In his new role, he will focus on revenue optimisation, system scaling and supporting growth across the lifestyle portfolio.

Also read → Revival English Bay opens in Vancouver’s West End

John Mootz has been promoted to Vice President of Restaurant & Beverage Operations. The promotion reflects the company’s continued focus on strengthening its food and beverage platform. Mootz brings more than 20 years of hospitality and food service experience, including leadership roles with Puccini Group and oversight of large-scale operations such as Colonial Williamsburg’s $32.5 million programme. In his expanded role, he will lead culinary strategy, operational performance and guest-facing programming across the portfolio.

### Hotel Equities Strengthens Leadership Team with Key Executive Appointments Across New Divisions 

 November 10, 2025 

Atlanta, GA – Hotel Equities (HE), a leading hospitality operator and developer, announces a series of strategic executive appointments across its Full Service, Focused Service, and Lifestyle divisions. These moves and additions will drive innovation, enhance performance, and help create lasting guest experiences across the portfolio—priorities for HE in generating long-term value for key owners and stakeholders.

“These executives bring exceptional talent and diverse industry experience to their newly created roles,” said Albert Smith, Chief Operating Officer of Hotel Equities. “Their leadership is integral as we continue to strengthen our lifestyle, full-, and select-service divisions across the U.S., Canada, and CALA, enhancing value for our owners and partners. By promoting from within, we’re investing in high performers who will help us grow our portfolio and expand our platform for innovation — from traditional hotels to new concepts like our leading outdoor hospitality brand, Postcard Cabins.”

Newly announced positions include:

Peter Tziahanas, President, Full Service Division

Peter Tziahanas joined Hotel Equities in 2021 and previously served as Executive Vice President of Operations, overseeing key lifestyle and owned assets across the firm’s portfolio. In his new role, he collaborates with internal and external stakeholders to drive operational excellence, profitability, and enhanced guest and employee engagement. Before joining HE, Peter held several multi-unit leadership positions with prominent management groups, including Pivot Hotels at Davidson Hospitality Group, where he successfully led the lifestyle operating vertical.

David Rosenberg, President, Focused Service Division

David Rosenberg joined Hotel Equities in 2020 and most recently served as Executive Vice President of Operations, where he oversaw the deployment of analytics-driven performance dashboards, managed M&A integrations, and led a substantial portion of HE’s multi-branded hotel portfolio. He also guided the company’s entry into the outdoor hospitality segment through the integration of Postcard Cabins into the portfolio. # Nolan Wrentmore Appointed Vice President of Revenue at Hotel Equities

Published on April 29, 2026

In a significant move to strengthen its leadership, Hotel Equities has appointed Nolan Wrentmore as Vice President of Revenue, Lifestyle Division. With more than 25 years of experience in revenue strategy, distribution, and commercial operations, Wrentmore brings a wealth of expertise to the role. His impressive track record includes leadership positions at Hosteeva and Aimbridge Hospitality, where he played an instrumental role in driving business growth and optimizing revenue streams.

### Proven Leadership in Revenue Strategy

Nolan Wrentmore has built a stellar reputation in the hospitality industry through his innovative approaches to revenue optimization. At Hosteeva, he helped propel the company’s revenue growth by more than 100 percent, marking a defining achievement in his career. This success was achieved through a combination of data-driven strategies, effective pricing models, and a keen focus on customer satisfaction. His extensive experience in overseeing large-scale commercial operations has made him a sought-after leader in the field of revenue management.

### Driving Growth Across the Lifestyle Portfolio

In his new role at Hotel Equities, Wrentmore will be responsible for advancing revenue optimization within the lifestyle division. This division, which includes a portfolio of lifestyle hotels, will benefit from Wrentmore’s vast expertise as he focuses on scaling systems to support continued growth. His efforts will play a crucial role in enhancing the profitability of properties and ensuring that the division is well-positioned to meet the demands of the evolving hospitality market.

### Legacy of Success in Hospitality

Before joining Hotel Equities, Nolan Wrentmore spent over a decade with Aimbridge Hospitality, where he oversaw a team managing more than $1 billion in annual revenue. His leadership at Aimbridge helped the company maintain its competitive edge by implementing effective revenue strategies and creating systems that maximized financial performance. Wrentmore’s expertise in managing large-scale revenue operations will be critical to his success at Hotel Equities as he works to streamline revenue management and drive profitability.

Hotel Equities Names Roger Miller Vice President of Sales & Marketing | Hotel Online

# Hotel Equities Names Roger Miller Vice President of Sales & Marketing

Mar 21, 2016 2 minute read

Industry veteran brings multi-brand full service, resort expertise and relationships to firm's leadership

ATLANTA, GA (March 17, 2016) – Atlanta-based Hotel Equities(HE) recently named Roger A. Miller the Vice President of Sales & Marketing for the firm.

A veteran of more than 20+ years in multi-unit hotel sales and marketing, Mr. Miller brings full service and select service brand expertise and leadership to his new position including a background in training, coaching and mentoring. In addition, he has a solid history of building collaborative business partnerships with owners, lenders, investors, asset managers and multiple brand representatives.

During his career, he has represented 150+ properties in 42 states, ranging from 60-600 rooms with combined assets in excess of $1.5B. Projects included development, conversion real estate, rebranding, repositioning and strong performing hotels. Brands represented included: Marriott (full, extended stay and select service), Hilton (full, extended stay and select service), Hyatt (full service), Starwood (full service), IHG (full and select service) and Choice Hotels.

Mr. Miller's responsibilities as Vice President of Sales & Marketing will include developing pre and post new hotel opening sales and marketing plans, rebranding and repositioning hotel sales & marketing plans and guiding new hotels from construction to opening with great ramp speed for success in their markets. He will oversee five regional directors of sales and marketing throughout the country.

"I am very excited to join the Hotel Equities' family," said Mr. Miller. "I appreciate the opportunity and look forward to contributing to our company's continued success and growth."

"We are thrilled to have someone with Roger's pedigree join the sales and marketing side of the firm," said Joe Reardon, Sr. Vice President of Marketing and Business Development.

Mr. Miller holds a B.A. degree from William Carey University in Hattiesburg, Mississippi. He and his wife reside in Atlanta.
